name: Solve this quantum programming problem. Implement a Loschmidt echo test in Cirq:
task_prompt: Solve this quantum programming problem. Implement a Loschmidt echo test in Cirq: evolve 3 qubits with 4 layers of random rotations U, apply U^dagger, and verify the system returns to |0...0> with probability 1; then perturb one angle by 0.16 and report the echo decay. Return the entire program in one piece, ready to run without any modification.
